checks: The Taro forgot-password form consumes a real administrator-issued one-time credential.
Mobile settings display current and revoked device families from the native API.
Confirmed password change clears mobile credentials and returns to login.
A current mobile device can revoke itself and leaves no authenticated screen.
Revoking another device keeps the current mobile login and reloads the committed state.
Password and authentication material are absent from generic browser storage.
scope: Taro H5 with real native API; no device or store approval claim
